messages:
Ravi Menon: Quick heads-up — ops runbook for the marketplace go-live tomorrow 14:00 PT. Need final go/no-go on partner assets, pricing table, and SI links by EOD today.

Gina Torres: I'll sign off on pricing. sending final CSV to the drive now: https://go/redwood/assets/pricing-v2.csv :paperclip:

Omar Khalid: Asset checklist from infra side: logos (svg/png), partner landing snippets, OAuth redirect URL for SI listings. Please upload to /assets/marketplace/ by 18:00 PT.

Priya Shah: Marketing note — hero variant B performed slightly better in tests. We'll default to B unless objections. Also need webinar CTA placement confirmed (top of page).

Noah Li: For SI integration links, CloudForge and VertexWorks need a sample listing template. I pushed a template here: https://go/redwood/docs/si-listing-template.md. Recommend copy/paste for partners.

OpsBot: Reminder scheduled: staging smoke-run at 2026-04-07T13:00:00-07:00. Will post results to #eng-oncall. :robot_face:

Omar Khalid: Staging deploy command for EngOps (run ~10m before go-live):
```
/eng-deploy promote marketplace-staging -> marketplace-prod --check=smoke --timeout=8m
```

Hannah Brooks: Legal quick check — embargo window locked to 2026-04-07 16:00 PT. No partner quotes or case studies live before that. Partners signed off on quote usage? If not, we list orgs without quotes.

LegalBot: All partner MSA clauses for joint announcements verified for VertexWorks and AmpereLabs. Pending: CloudForge IP attestation doc (expected today).

Priya Shah: Copy owners: I'll own hero + CTAs, Hannah will own legal copy, Gina owns pricing table, Ravi + Omar handle staging cutover. Please add short approval comment in the doc.

Ravi Menon: Backstop plan if an SI misses assets: list integration as "Coming soon" and enable mailing list sign-up. Don't delay launch over missing logos.

Noah Li: Also adding a telemetry checkbox: ensure marketplace events emit `marketplace.view` and `marketplace.signup` — QA please verify post-deploy.

Gina Torres: Uploaded final pricing CSV and partners.csv. :thumbsup:

Priya Shah: OK all — if no objections, we'll proceed with dry-run at 13:00 PT and final push at 16:00 PT. Thanks. :pray:
